goals.title: Step 1: Surface critic 'no parlay' + why on early-exit
goals.description: In src/swarm/engine/index.ts, exclude the critic seat from the all-placeholder / isDataRequest test (stamp role or seat on reports if needed). If remaining seats are empty, still early-exit, but put critic's summary/insights into summary (and analysis if used) while keeping picks: [] and critic verdict.
goals.verificationCriteria: Critic-only actionable 'no parlay' is visible on the early-exit result.

goals.title: Step 2: Parse Llama {type,name,parameters} function-call JSON
goals.description: In src/swarm/tools/registry.ts parseToolCalls addCandidate, accept tool name from parsed.tool ?? parsed.name ?? parsed.function?.name, and args from parsed.parameters ?? parsed.arguments ?? {}. Strip trailing _v1 to resolve to registered short name. Do not treat 'json' as a tool.
goals.verificationCriteria: Llama {type:'function', name:'get_market_movement', parameters:{game_id}} parses as that tool call.

goals.title: Step 3: Wrap bare pick arrays instead of placeholdering
goals.description: In src/swarm/parser/responseGuards.ts guardAnalystResponse, if raw (or parsed input) is an array of pick-like objects, wrap into {analysis, picks, scorecards} keeping pick/game identity, stripping odds and stake, and filling insights/summary from pick labels.
goals.verificationCriteria: A bare HOU ML array is a real report with picks and no odds/stake, not a placeholder.

goals.title: Step 4: Repro and unit tests
goals.description: Create src/__repro__/chatEmptyOutput.repro.test.ts covering inverted A/B, C critic isDataRequest + early-exit summary containing 'no parlay'.
goals.verificationCriteria: All repro and early-exit tests pass.

goals.title: Step 5: Verify, push fix/chat-empty-output, and open PR
goals.description: Node 22 strip-only check, vitest on touched and full suite, tsc --noEmit, smoke-start, push fix/chat-empty-output to origin, open PR on GitHub with required body.
goals.verificationCriteria: Verification passes; PR opened on GitHub.
